text: CONTRADICTING: After challenge with organoid debris, APOE33 iMG late endosomes/lysosomes acidified further (pH ~5.15 to ~5.05), whereas isogenic APOE44 iMG failed to acidify. Under challenge, APOE4 compartments were therefore less acidic (higher pH) than APOE3, not more acidic (reported: APOE33 pH ~5.15 to ~5.05 on challenge; APOE44 no further acidification).
description: Isogenic APOE33 (JIPSC001000) and APOE44 (JIPSC001150) KOLF2.1J (male) human iPSCs differentiated into microglia (iMG). Cells were treated with organoid debris for ~48 h, loaded overnight with 70 kDa dextran labeled with ApHID (pH-sensitive) and Alexa 647 (pH-independent), chased 4 h, then imaged ratiometrically and calibrated to pH. Bafilomycin controls included. n=3 wells per condition, 9 frames per well; one-way ANOVA. Caveat: microglia, not astrocytes; measures the late endosomal/lysosomal compartment, not early endosomes; iPSC-derived cells.

provenance.excerpt: While baseline LE/Ly pH did not differ between APOE33 and APOE44 iMG (~5.15), APOE33 iMG exhibited further acidification upon challenge (~5.05), whereas APOE44 iMG failed to do so (Figure 3G).

meccogFinding.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) + organoid debris challenge -> failure of late endosome/lysosome acidification (higher LE/Ly pH than APOE3) in iPSC-derived microglia [CONTRADICTS]

warnings: effect size 'APOE33 pH ~5.15 to ~5.05 on challenge; APOE44 no further acidification' has no accepted form: recorded as qualitative, numbers kept in description

perturbed.variable: APOE44 vs APOE33 genotype (isogenic KOLF2.1J iPSC-derived microglia), challenged with organoid debris

measured.variable: Late endosomal/lysosomal luminal pH (ratiometric ApHID/Alexa647 dextran) after debris challenge
